Why some people spring out of bed before dawn.

Kevin Trudeau tells of a ski trip where his friends leapt up at four in the morning to hit the slopes while he stayed in bed. Then they joined him fishing, and the roles flipped.

Kevin explains that when your thinking is right about what you love, you feel motivated and excited, and action follows naturally.

What would get you out of bed at four in the morning?
